subject.name: JANUS Proof-of-Observation / Native Flow Gate
subject.research_role: evidence-first experimental methodology for controlled Proof-of-Work runtime cohort segmentation

replicated_engineering_result.validated_statement: The Native Flow Gate reproducibly creates distinct new computational cohorts after drained admission valleys in one live run process.

what_is_distinctive.known_systems_idea: Admission control, worker draining, quiescence and cohort separation are established systems concepts.
what_is_distinctive.candidate_delta: Use controlled open/hold/drain/reopen runtime segmentation as an experimentally frozen, hash-bound measurement primitive inside a live Proof-of-Work process, with native/sham matching, boundary-integrity telemetry, negative results and strict prohibition on converting cohort segmentation into a hash-quality/mining claim.
what_is_distinctive.proof_of_observation_principle: Separate 'we changed/segmented the computational exposure in a reproducible way' from 'the outcome distribution improved'. The first can be proven as an engineering observation while the second remains a separately falsifiable challenge.

novelty_assessment.candidate_claim: Evidence-first PoW runtime measurement protocol that creates and independently audits native computational cohorts without restart, while freezing hash/target/submit semantics and preserving sham controls and negative outcomes.

safe_public_claims.short: I developed and replicated a Proof-of-Observation methodology for auditable Proof-of-Work runtime experiments, including a Native Flow Gate that reproducibly segments new computational cohorts in one live process.
safe_public_claims.technical: A18.42 replicated native wave segmentation across 40/40 discovery runs and 56/56 audited drained boundaries, with 16/16 native/sham matched candidate pairs and strict exclusion of any claim of SHA-256 or mining advantage.
do_not_claim: proof that cohort segmentation changes cryptographic output distribution

next_scientific_gate: freeze an outcome challenge that can fail despite perfect wave segmentation
run blinded/randomized native versus sham comparisons with outcome statistics separated from exposure integrity
publish raw redacted telemetry sufficient for independent replay
perform a dedicated systems/mining prior-art and patent search
